# Lucy

## Overview

- **Age:** Seven years old (in volume 2)  <sub>[v1 c18 P28](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0028), [v2 c1 P31](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0031), [v2 c7 P30](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0030), [v2 c10 P8](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0008)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c18 P21](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0021), [v2 c1 P31](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0031)</sub>
- **Origin:** East Welby  <sub>[v1 c27 P5](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0005), [v2 c1 P29](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0029), [v2 c8 P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001)</sub>
- **Role:** School pupil  <sub>[v2 c21 P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000)</sub>

## Appearance

Lucy is a slender, fair-haired girl with gentle, mild hazel eyes, a straight nose, and long, sleek, fawn-colored curls that are always kept perfectly neat. She has a 'prunes and prisms' expression on her small mouth and is described as looking like she was recently starched and ironed. Although considered quite pretty, she is prone to crying when her clothes get dirty or when her brother pulls her hair.

_Sources: [v1 c18 P28](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0028), [v2 c1 P31](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0031), [v2 c5 P6](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0006), [v2 c8 P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001), [v2 c8 P6](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0006), [v2 c8 P25](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0025), [v2 c8 P26](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0026), [v2 c8 P44](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0044)_

## Personality

Lucy is extremely quiet, well-behaved, obedient, and polite. She is dependable, neat, and conscientious about completing small household chores. However, she is also easily frightened, quite timid, and lacks imagination or much individuality. She reacts to distress by weeping and is easily intimidated by her lively twin brother, Robin.

_Sources: [v1 c18 P28](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0028), [v1 c18 P30](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0030), [v2 c1 P31](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0031), [v2 c1 P34](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0034), [v2 c8 P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001), [v2 c8 P6](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0006), [v2 c8 P44](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0044), [v2 c8 P48](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0048), [v2 c10 P88](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0088), [v2 c16 P15](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0015), [v2 c21 P2](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0002)_

## History

Lucy's mother, Mary Farrow, fell gravely ill in East Welby and requested that her third cousin, Thirza Abernethy, take in Lucy and her twin brother, Robin. When Mary passed away, Thirza brought Lucy and Robin to live at Grey Shutters. Though Lucy was extremely well-behaved and neat, she suffered from her twin brother's mischievous pranks, such as having her hair pulled or being tricked into standing on a pigpen fence and falling in. During her first winter at Grey Shutters, her uncle in British Columbia passed away, leaving a two-thousand-dollar trust fund for the twins, ensuring their permanent residence at Grey Shutters. In the autumn after turning seven, she began attending Brierley School alongside Robin.

_Sources: [v1 c18 P28](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0028), [v1 c27 P5](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0005), [v2 c1 P29](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0029), [v2 c1 P34](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0034), [v2 c7 P25](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0025), [v2 c7 P32](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0032), [v2 c8 P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001), [v2 c8 P6](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0006), [v2 c8 P46](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0046), [v2 c8 P47](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0047), [v2 c10 P86](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0086), [v2 c21 P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000), [v2 c22 P22](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0022), [v2 c22 P23](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0023)_
